svg.title: paddock: the status dot
svg.desc: Recorded from paddock 0.5.0 in a scratch tmux server; staged sessions. Shows a dot beside each window that has an agent. Steps: 1. Your tmux, unchanged: a dot beside each window that has an agent. 2. Finished: the dot turns blue.

g.text: I'll start with how the checkout handlers are wired.
A token bucket keyed on the customer id fits. I'll add it as middleware.
I'll start with how the checkout handlers are wired.
A token bucket keyed on the customer id fits. I'll add it as middleware.
Added a token-bucket limiter keyed on the customer id: requests past 20 a
minute get a 429 with Retry-After. 4 tests pass.
